title: CSS Color Level 5
impact: Umbrella opened by the maintainer in 2022; 7 reactions. The most-used parts (color-mix, relative colors, light-dark, alpha()) are done. The main remaining gap with real-world demand is contrast-color(), which now ships in all three engines.
summary: Supported: color-mix() with an explicit color space and two colors, relative color syntax, light-dark() (colors, and images via the var() lowering), and alpha() (since 1.33.0). Missing: contrast-color() (open PRs #808, #1160), the new color-mix() forms (optional color space, more than two colors; tracked in #1224), the display-p3-linear color space (tracked in #1161), and the at-risk features no browser ships (device-cmyk(), @color-profile, custom color spaces). Unsupported syntax passes through unchanged as tokens, not lowered and with no error, so nothing is broken in strict mode.
repro: 99-repro.mjs: one case per feature (controls for supported features, desired behavior for missing ones, passthrough checks for at-risk ones).
evidence: scripts/repro.mjs on local (master) + 1.33.0, 1.32.0, 1.31.1. Spec: css-color-5 ED Overview.bs (Status: ED; the 2026 changes list puts custom color spaces, @color-profile, device-cmyk() and relative alpha colors at risk; contrast-color(<color>) resolves to white or black with a UA-defined algorithm). @mdn/browser-compat-data 8.0.7 (repo node_modules). Chromium 153 probe: contrast-color(red)/(#777) -> black, #666/navy -> white (consistent with the WCAG 2 maximum); color-mix(red, blue) is supported, the three-color form is not; device-cmyk is not supported.

fix.approach: Each case separately. contrast-color(): per the maintainer's #1160 comment, resolve known colors to black/white at build time (no CssColor::ContrastColor variant needed) and keep var()/currentColor unresolved; scope #808 down to the level 5 syntax (no `max`, no level 6 candidate list).

openPRs.assessment: Parse-only: adds CssColor::ContrastColor plus UnresolvedColor::ContrastColor, keeps contrast-color(...) as written (no lowering). Has tests. The maintainer asked for build-time resolution, which would remove the new AST variant; the author argued the L5 algorithm is subpar. Unresolved design disagreement.

Resolves at build time with WCAG 2 contrast; also accepts the `max` keyword (since removed from the L5 ED) and L6 `tbd-bg wcag2, <colors>` behind a `level6` cargo feature. Old (2024) and needs a rebase. The maintainer suggested scoping it down to L5. Its luminance calculation is a closer starting point for what the maintainer wants.

draftReply:
Status update on Color 5 as of 1.33.0:

**Supported:** `color-mix()` (explicit color space, two colors), relative color syntax, `light-dark()` (colors, and now images), and `alpha()` (new in 1.33.0).

**Missing:**
- `contrast-color()`: now shipped in Chrome, Firefox and Safari. There are two open PRs, #808 and #1160, that address it.
- The newer `color-mix()` forms (optional color space, more than two colors): tracked in #1224.
- The `display-p3-linear` color space: tracked in #1161.
- `device-cmyk()`, `@color-profile` and custom color spaces: no browser supports them and the spec marks them at risk. They pass through unchanged.

Unsupported syntax currently passes through as written, without being lowered for older browsers.
